title: AD PULCRITUDINEM TRIA REQUIRUNTUR INTEGRITAS, CONSONANTIA, CLARITAS.
html_source:
A more literal translation from the Latin for the three is:
Beauty requires three things: Integrity, Harmony, and Clarity.

Incidentally, these three are pretty easy cognates to English.

anchor.text: AD PULCRITUDINEM TRIA REQUIRUNTUR INTEGRITAS, CONSONANTIA, CLARITAS.
